summary: User Story SD-008 - ATP check excluding batches nearing expiration

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can create a Sales Order for a batch-managed pharmaceutical material.
The system performs an ATP check against all unrestricted stock batches.
The system excludes batches from the ATP calculation if their remaining shelf-life is less than the minimum required shelf-life threshold (configurable by material, e.g., 6 months before expiration).
The system confirms availability and proposes a delivery date only if sufficient stock with adequate shelf-life exists.
The system displays a warning message if the ATP check fails due to insufficient stock with adequate shelf-life, even if physical stock is available.
The system allows the user to override the shelf-life restriction with appropriate authorization (e.g., for discount sales or urgent orders).

HP.description: Create Sales Order for batch-managed pharmaceutical material with sufficient stock having adequate shelf-life (> min threshold), ATP check passes, delivery date confirmed, order saved successfully

AP.description: User with override authorization creates Sales Order and manually overrides shelf-life restriction to use a batch nearing expiration (e.g., discount sale scenario), order saved successfully

NEG.description: Create Sales Order for batch-managed material where all available batches have remaining shelf-life < min threshold, ATP check fails, warning message displayed, order cannot be saved
User without override authorization attempts to override shelf-life restriction, system rejects override, order cannot proceed with near-expiration batch
Create Sales Order for batch-managed material with zero unrestricted stock, ATP check fails, warning message displayed (standard ATP failure, not shelf-life specific)
Create Sales Order for material that is NOT batch-managed (MARA.XCHPF = blank), system performs standard ATP check without shelf-life logic (feature not applicable)

ERR.description: Invalid Customer ID (does not exist in customer master)
Invalid Material ID (does not exist in material master)
Material not extended to Sales Org/Distribution Channel (MVKE entry missing)

EDGE.description: Batch expiration date exactly equals (current date + min shelf-life threshold) — boundary condition — verify if batch is included or excluded from ATP
Order Quantity equals exact available ATP stock (with shelf-life filter applied) — full consumption — verify delivery date and stock allocation
Order Quantity exceeds available ATP stock (with shelf-life filter applied) by 1 unit — verify ATP failure warning
Requested Delivery Date is today (same day) — verify ATP check uses today as base date for shelf-life calculation
Minimum shelf-life threshold configured as 0 days (no restriction) — verify all batches included in ATP regardless of expiration date
Material has multiple batches: one with adequate shelf-life (> threshold), one near expiration (< threshold) — verify system selects only adequate batch

input.name: customerId

input.name: materialId
input.label: Material
input.validRange: Existing batch-managed pharmaceutical material with shelf-life config (MARA.XCHPF = 'X', MHDHB populated)

input.name: salesOrganization
input.label: Sales Organization
input.validRange: Valid sales org from TVKO table

input.name: distributionChannel
input.label: Distribution Channel
input.validRange: Valid distribution channel from TVTW table

input.name: overrideShelfLife
input.label: Override Shelf-Life (checkbox or flag)
input.validRange: Only if user has override authorization

output.name: deliveryDateConfirmed
output.label: System-confirmed delivery date based on ATP

output.name: atpWarningMessage
output.label: Warning message if ATP fails due to shelf-life
output.format: Text: 'No sufficient stock with required shelf-life available' (exact text TBD per SAP tenant config)

output.name: batchAllocation
output.label: Batches allocated to the Sales Order line item

boundary.name: batchExpirationDate
boundary.label: Batch Expiration Date
